title: The permissions section shows the resource cards with their columns
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Create Role page (template skipped).
custom_steps: 1. Look at the permission cards and their columns.
custom_expected: The cards are: Work orders (View/Create & Edit/Delete plus View mode and the Review work orders / Pick parts / Order parts sub-items); Work order lines (Create & Edit/Delete, no View); Schedule; Customers; Invoicing & payments (delete column labelled Delete / Reverse); Timesheets (View and Create & Edit, no Delete); and the Parts Department card with its three children (Part sales, Catalog and Inventory, Vendor and order management).
